continuity_scope: Bounded published orientation pass using UNESCO’s Ifá safeguarding description and a deliberately limited set of widely published named figures. It does not exhaust Yorùbá lineages, regions, recensions, practice, or living authority.

work_or_witnesses.edition: UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage inscription description

coverage_rule: Named figures needed to represent a limited published orientation to òrìṣà, Ifá mediation, waters, healing, power, and ancestral narrative; ritual offices are terms, not nodes.
omissions: Most òrìṣà, local forms, lineages, verses, practitioners, and living ceremonial contexts
All claims of universal portfolios, genealogies, or ritual procedure
uncertainties: Published names and associations vary by region and lineage.
UNESCO description is contextual orientation, not a substitute for primary oral authority.
Several relationships are low-confidence and require a dedicated scholarly text witness before integration.
evidence_basis: UNESCO safeguarding documentation is the identified institutional published reference; all records are strongly caveated and require lineage-aware review.

citations.locator: UNESCO Ifa divination system inscription description
supports: Institutional context for the bounded pass.
